best_lineage.idea: Implement columnar compression by parsing the log into fields (IP, Timestamp, Method, Path, Protocol, Status, Size, Referer, User-Agent), using dictionary encoding for repetitive strings, and compressing the resulting structured payload with LZMA to maximize the compression ratio.
Remove the incorrect empty-data handling that causes LZMAError on empty inputs.
